reviews.text:
I've been using this cream for a few weeks now and I really love it! It has a light gel texture that absorbs quickly and doesn't feel greasy at all. It instantly makes my skin feel fresh and hydrated. noticed my skin looks more even and less dull - it definitely helped brighten my face and fade some dark spots. I also didn't get any breakouts from it, which is rare for
me. Perfect for daytime under
sunscreen and also works great at night. Will keep using it!
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款面霜幾個星期，我真係好鍾意！佢質地似輕盈嘅啫喱，吸收得好快，一啲都唔油膩。即刻令我皮膚感覺清新、水潤。我留意到皮膚睇落更均勻、冇咁暗淡——佢確實幫手提亮咗面色，淡化咗啲色斑。我亦都冇因為佢而爆痘，呢點對我嚟講好少見。日間喺防曬下面用好啱，晚上用都好好。我會繼續用！

reviews.text: I've been using this gel moisturizer for 2 years now and it's my second time repurchasing this. I have acne scars and ever since ive started using this gel moisturizer my scars have faded and it's good for my oily skin acne prone skin, it moisturizes my face and it doesn't leave my skin feeling oily after applying it and yet it doesn't leave my skin feeling dry. I've been using this after breakout and during my acne scarring stage, and it does a wonderful job with healing my scars.
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款啫喱保濕霜兩年，而家係第二次再買。我有痘印，自從開始用呢款啫喱保濕霜，我嘅痘印淡咗。佢啱我嘅油性同易生暗瘡嘅皮膚，可以保濕，搽完唔會令皮膚油膩，但又唔會令皮膚乾燥。我喺爆痘之後同痘印階段都一直用，佢幫我修復痘印，效果好好。

reviews.text: I'm so glad I watched a yt short recommending gel moisturizers for oily, acne-prone skin cause this works nicely at limiting breakouts, hydrating my skin, keeping the benefits of other products locked in and not looking so greasy throughout the day. My redness is improving too, I think. Would definitely purchase again.
reviews.zh: 我好高興我睇咗個 YouTube Shorts，推薦油性、易生暗瘡嘅皮膚用啫喱保濕霜，因為呢款好能夠減少爆痘、保濕，鎖住其他產品嘅效果，而且成日都唔會睇落咁油膩。我覺得我嘅泛紅都有改善。一定會再買。

reviews.text:
very light mostiurizer, feels refreshing and cooling so its great for the summer... it is a watery gel with a very slight yellow hue, smells citrusy but the scent is also light
seems to be helping with acne scars but i have also used with other products, does not help with redness though!
reviews.zh:
保濕霜質地好輕盈，感覺清爽、清涼，所以夏天用好好。佢係水狀啫喱，帶少少淡黃色，有柑橘味，不過味道都好淡。
好似幫到暗瘡疤痕，但係我都有配其他產品一齊用。對紅位就冇幫助！

reviews.text: I've always wanted a product that has Yuja in it, it's rich in natural vitamin C which is perfect for acne marks and dark spots and combats skin's premature aging, I got the trial kit to start and loved it. So I got the full size bottle. It's light and penetrates fast. Quite refreshing for my inflamed skin. Smell is pleasant too.
reviews.zh: 我一直都好想有一款含柚子嘅產品，佢富含天然維他命 C，好適合用嚟處理痘印同色斑，又可以對抗皮膚早衰。我先買咗試用套裝嚟試，結果好鍾意，所以買咗全尺寸嘅樽裝。佢質地輕，吸收好快。對我發炎嘅皮膚嚟講，幾清爽。香味都好好聞。

reviews.text: Its jelly gel, but it doesn't feel sticky, it helped with hyperpigmentation but I'm not sure how much of a job eas done with this alone bc I used other brightening products with this. I like to use it as a morning moisturiser for summer, bc my oily skin needs only whisper of moisture at that time. Overal it's a good product.
reviews.zh: 佢係果凍啫喱質地，但係唔會黏。佢幫手改善咗色素沉澱，不過我唔肯定單靠佢做咗幾多嘢，因為我同時用緊其他提亮產品。我鍾意夏天用佢做早上嘅保濕霜，因為嗰陣我嘅油性皮膚只需要一絲絲水分。整體嚟講係一款好產品。

reviews.text: I love it! I was looking for a vitamin C product but scared to try a strong serum. I have very sensitive skin with adult acne and rosacea. This gel is so gentle, I can use it everyday with no irritation, redness or break outs. It is a very light nonsticky gel. It has a very light naturally occurring smell of oranges. I would highly recommend!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意！我一直想搵維他命 C 產品，但又驚試強效精華。我嘅皮膚好敏感，有成人痘同玫瑰痤瘡。呢款啫喱好溫和，我每日都可以用，冇刺激、冇紅、亦冇爆痘。佢係一款好輕、唔黏嘅啫喱。有一陣好淡嘅天然橙香味。我非常推薦！

reviews.text: I have a very dry skin and this product is helping me to moisturize my skin and I love it. The smell is very light citrusy and the texture is quickly absorbed without any stickiness to the skin. Overall is very good skincare and very recommended especially if you have a dry skin like mine 😊
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚好乾，呢款產品幫我保濕，我好鍾意。佢嘅香味好淡，有柑橘嘅味道，質地吸收得好快，皮膚上冇任何黏膩感。整體嚟講係一款好好嘅護膚品，特別推薦畀好似我咁乾性皮膚嘅人 😊
